entries.rationale: 15/20. BEH-11 is fully specified, but this branch deliberately bypasses project-root containment: the plugin root must derive from getPluginRoot() and never from CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT. Security-relevant edit spanning lib/cli and lib/evals with no curated CLI-verb sample. Checkpoint after RED.

16/20. Prose-only SKILL.md edit with the exact lines named and mirrors regenerated by the sync script. Blast radius 3: skills/eval/SKILL.md is governed by no-inline-node-in-skills and the pre-commit hook rejects at commit time, and the provider parity gate follows.

16/20. Docs correction plus a scoped sweep whose scope, exclusions, match rule and exact pre-state (2 matches, docs/cli-reference.md:851-852) are all pinned. The repo already carries the sweep-test idiom in tests/skills-no-inline-node.test.mjs.

16/20. Single test file, re-anchoring one regex and adding one assertion. Spec 4 rather than 5: the anchor sentence is the prose Task 2 writes, so the exact target is inferred from Task 2's output rather than fixed in advance.

15/20, driven by pattern coverage 2. No in-repo precedent composes a temp plugin-root copy outside the project root, a spawned dispatch(), a decoy CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT via env:, and a prose-extracted --rubric argument. Each weakened property already passed against broken code, so review the RED before GREEN.

18/20. Mechanical housekeeping: 11 named paths plus the four files Tasks 1-5 create, stamped by adev source-manifest compute, and two comment blocks replaced. No code changes; pre/post file count 17 to 32 is the falsifiable check.
